description.value: Booster Juice is a Canadian smoothie and juice bar chain founded in 1999 in Alberta, specializing in blended-to-order smoothies, fresh-pressed juices, açaí bowls, and healthy grab-and-go snacks. This River District branch sits in a newer mixed-use neighbourhood on Vancouver's south shore and offers indoor seating. It's a convenient refuelling stop for cyclists looking for a quick, nutritious liquid meal.
